title: Add a pre-commit gitleaks scan alongside git-secrets
description: Extend .husky/pre-commit in applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, which currently runs only `git-secrets --register-aws && git-secrets --scan` (AWS patterns), with a gitleaks staged scan after it, for example `gitleaks protect --staged --redact`, so staged content is checked by the same tool the policy pins for the secrets gate (company-profile/example-co/sdlc/policy.json ciGates secrets: gitleaks, blocking at low, secretsManagement.scanningInCi true). Keep the change confined to the hook file; do not modify .github/workflows/code-health.yml or any CI gate definition; use gitleaks at the version pinned in the scanner toolchain (8.30.1) and make the hook fail with a clear message when gitleaks is missing instead of skipping the scan. Land through the same reviewed PR flow as tasks 1 and 2; no deployment window applies and the unit-test gate must stay green.
acceptanceCriteria: .husky/pre-commit contains a redacted gitleaks staged scan that runs after the existing git-secrets --register-aws && git-secrets --scan

With the hook installed, staging a scratch file holding a synthetic high-entropy canary string (never a real credential) makes the hook exit non-zero and blocks the commit; removing the file lets the commit succeed
The pre-existing unit-test and secrets CI gates are green on the PR branch and no CI workflow file changed

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer inspects the .husky/pre-commit diff (a gitleaks protect --staged --redact invocation after the git-secrets scan, no CI workflow files changed), then stages a scratch file holding a synthetic high-entropy canary string in the checkout and invokes the hook directly, expecting a non-zero exit and a blocked commit, and expects the hook to pass once the canary file is removed.

rootCause.description: The local pre-commit hook was configured with git-secrets AWS patterns only, weaker than the company secrets gate (gitleaks blocking at low), so generic high-entropy secrets in staged .env variants or key files were missed at the developer layer.
